# SDK API reference

Every public type of `AutoSettings.Sdk` 1.0.0 (namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk`). Start with
[Writing a .NET plugin](../dotnet-plugins.md) for how they fit together.

## Interfaces you implement

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| [`IPlugin`](IPlugin.md) | The entry point of a .NET plugin. AutoSettings creates one instance of the class that implements it (the class needs a public parameterless constructor) and calls [`IPlugin.Configure`](IPlugin.md#configure) once when the plugin starts. |
| [`IPluginAction`](IPluginAction.md) | An action: changes something when an automation runs or a profile is applied. |
| [`IPluginCondition`](IPluginCondition.md) | A condition: must be true for an automation to run. |
| [`IPluginTrigger`](IPluginTrigger.md) | A trigger source: runs while the plugin is loaded and raises events with [`ITriggerSink.Raise`](ITriggerSink.md#raise). Automations react to them through the trigger types the class declares. |
| [`IRevertiblePluginAction`](IRevertiblePluginAction.md) | An action that profiles can undo. Before a profile changes a setting for the first time, AutoSettings calls [`IRevertiblePluginAction.CaptureAsync`](IRevertiblePluginAction.md#captureasync) to save the current value; when the profile ends it calls [`IRevertiblePluginAction.RestoreAsync`](IRevertiblePluginAction.md#restoreasync) with that value. |

## Interfaces AutoSettings gives you

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| [`IPluginBuilder`](IPluginBuilder.md) | Collects the components of a plugin in [`IPlugin.Configure`](IPlugin.md#configure). |
| [`IPluginLog`](IPluginLog.md) | Writes to the AutoSettings activity log (the Activity page). |
| [`ITriggerSink`](ITriggerSink.md) | Raises plugin events. |

## Attributes

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| [`FieldAttribute`](FieldAttribute.md) | Declares a parameter of the component classes it is put on. |
| [`LocalizedAttribute`](LocalizedAttribute.md) | A translated title and description for a component, for example in Turkish. |
| [`PluginComponentAttribute`](PluginComponentAttribute.md) | Describes a component: its type as written in YAML, its title and what it does. Put it on every class passed to [`IPluginBuilder`](IPluginBuilder.md). A trigger class can have several, one per event it raises. |

## Enums

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| [`FieldKind`](FieldKind.md) | The type of a field, which decides how it is checked and which control the editor shows. |
| [`PluginAvailability`](PluginAvailability.md) | Which automation files a trigger or condition may be used in. |
| [`PluginScope`](PluginScope.md) | Where something runs. |

## Classes and records

| Type | Description |
|---|---|
| [`ActionRequest`](ActionRequest.md) | What an action gets when it runs. |
| [`ConditionRequest`](ConditionRequest.md) | What a condition gets when it is checked. |
| [`Parameters`](Parameters.md) | The parameters of an action or condition, as written in the automation (for example `drive: "E:"`). Values have already been checked against the fields the component declares, so a required field is always there and has the declared type. |
| [`PluginActionException`](PluginActionException.md) | Thrown by an action to report a failure the user can understand, for example "drive E: is not connected". |
| [`PluginEventInfo`](PluginEventInfo.md) | The event that started an automation. |
| [`PluginUser`](PluginUser.md) | A Windows user account. |
| [`SdkInfo`](SdkInfo.md) | Version information about this SDK. |
